title: Reminder SMS with one-tap reschedule link vs standard reminder (synthetic)

hypothesis.statement: Because owners reported rescheduling by text takes repeated back-and-forth messages (AIOPS-EV-002) and booking changes are frequent (AIOPS-EV-003), we believe adding a one-tap reschedule link to the 24-hour reminder SMS will reduce no-shows for end customers of small service businesses.
hypothesis.prediction: The share of appointments recorded as no-show falls from 12% to 9% or lower.

primary_metric.name: no_show_rate
primary_metric.definition: Appointments marked no-show by the business within 24 hours after the slot / all appointments that received a 24-hour reminder SMS in the experiment window

randomisation_unit: tenant (business) account - all of a tenant's customers see the same variant, avoiding cross-contamination within one business
stopping_rule: Run for the full 28 days or until 1,700 reminded appointments per arm, whichever is later; stop early only if a guardrail is breached.

ethics.consent_note: Pilot tenants (synthetic) agreed to service-improvement experiments in the pilot terms; tenants can opt out in settings; no change to prices, availability or cancellation fees; end customers can reply STOP to any SMS.
ethics.harm_review: Reminder wording reviewed so customers are not pressured; the reschedule link never cancels without confirmation.

decision_rule.ship_if: Two-sided p < 0.05, CI entirely below 0 (fewer no-shows) and no guardrail breached
decision_rule.do_not_ship_if: Any guardrail breached, or CI lower bound > -0.01 absolute

baseline_source: Synthetic pilot export PX-AIOPS-2026-09, 4 weeks; real baseline to be measured in alpha
